cards.text:
APL 移动豁免耐伤
星际战士连长
3 6" 3+ 15
名称攻击命中伤害武器规则
等离子手枪（标准） 4 3+ 3/5 范围 8"、穿刺 1
等离子手枪（过载） 4 3+ 4/5 范围 8"、过热、致命 5+、穿刺 1
动力拳套 5 3+ 5/7 残暴
英勇领袖：每个转折点限一次，您可以使用以下一
个效果：
• 在使用一个交战计谋时（指挥重掷除外），如果
该特工是计谋指定的死亡天使特工，那么那次
计谋消耗 0CP。
• 如果该特工位于杀戮区并且不位于敌方特工的
控制范围内，那么在您激活一个死亡天使特工
时，您可以使用“战斗条令”战略计谋（照常花
费 CP)。请注意，如果您已经在转折点中使用了
这个计谋，那么您不能选择本选项。
• 如果该特工位于杀戮区并且不位于敌方特工的控
制范围内，那么您可以消耗 0CP 使用“调整条
令”交战计谋。
钢铁光环：每场战斗限一次，在一枚攻击骰对该特
工造成普通伤害时，您可以忽略那次造成的伤害。
死亡天使、帝国、阿斯塔特修会、队长、星际战士连长 40
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
SPACE MARINE CAPTAIN
3 6" 3+ 15
NAME ATK HIT DMG WR
Plasma pistol (standard) 4 3+ 3/5 Range 8", Piercing 1
Plasma pistol (supercharge) 4 3+ 4/5 Range 8", Hot, Lethal 5+, Piercing 1
Power fist 5 3+ 5/7 Brutal
Heroic Leader: Once per turning point, you can do one of the following:
• Use a firefight ploy for 0CP if this is the specified ANGEL OF DEATH operative (excluding Command Re-roll).
• Use the Combat Doctrine strategy ploy when you activate a friendly ANGEL OF DEATH operative if this operative is in the
killzone and isn’t within control range of enemy operatives (pay its CP cost as normal). Note that you cannot do so if you’ve already
used that ploy during this turning point.
• Use the Adjust Doctrine firefight ploy for 0CP if this operative is in the killzone and isn’t within control range of enemy operatives.
Iron Halo: Once per battle, when an attack dice inflicts Normal Dmg on this operative, you can ignore that inflicted damage.
ANGEL OF DEATH , IMPERIUM, ADEPTUS ASTARTES, LEADER, SPACE MARINE CAPTAIN 40

cards.text:

突击仲裁者军士
3 6" 3+ 15
条令战争：您在每场战斗中可以使用以下效果各
一次：
• 每当您使用战斗条令战略计谋并选择毁灭条令
时，如果该特工位于杀戮区内，那么这次计谋的
消耗为 0CP。
• 每当您使用战斗条令战略计谋并选择战术条令
时，如果该特工位于杀戮区内，那么这次计谋的
消耗为 0CP。
战团老兵：在选择特工步骤结束时，如果该特工被
选择部署，那么为其选择额外一个在战斗中生效的
战团战术。与主要和次要战团战术不同的是，您
不需要在战役或比赛的每一场战斗中选择相同的
规则。
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
ASSAULT INTERCESSOR SERGEANT
3 6" 3+ 15
Doctrine Warfare: You can do each of the following once
per battle:
• Whenever you would use the Combat Doctrine strategy ploy
and then select Assault, if this operative is in the killzone, it
costs you 0CP.
• Whenever you would use the Combat Doctrine strategy ploy
and then select Tactical, if this operative is in the killzone, it
costs you 0CP.
Chapter Veteran: At the end of the Select Operatives step, if
this operative is selected for deployment, select one additional
CHAPTER TACTIC for it to have for the battle. Unlike primary
and secondary CHAPTER TACTICS, you don’t have to select
the same one for each battle in a campaign or tournament.

cards.image: 01-12-特工能力-歼灭者狙击手-能力卡.png
cards.text:
APL 移动豁免耐伤
歼灭者狙击手
3 7" 3+ 12
迷彩斗篷：每当一名特工对该特工进行射击时，忽
略“集中”武器规则。该特工拥有隐匿战团战术。
如果您选择了这个战团战术，那么您可以一同使用
规则的两个选项（也就是说，保留两个掩护豁免，
一次为普通成功，另一次为关键成功)。
瞄准 1AP
直到该特工的下一次激活开始前，每当其进行射
击时，敌方特工不能被遮挡。
该特工不能在敌方特工的控制范围内执行此行动。
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
ELIMINATOR SNIPER
3 7" 3+ 12
Camo Cloak: Whenever an operative is shooting this operative,
ignore the Saturate weapon rule. This operative has the Stealthy
CHAPTER TACTIC. If you selected that CHAPTER TACTIC,
you can do both of its options (i.e. retain two cover saves – one
normal and one critical success).
OPTICS 1AP
Until the start of this operative’s next activation, whenever
it’s shooting, enemy operatives cannot be obscured.
This operative cannot perform this action while within control
range of an enemy operative.

cards.image: 10-01-小队选择-死亡天使杀戮小队-1.png
cards.text:
死亡天使
杀戮小队
原型：安全保护，搜索与摧毁
特工
↘ 1 名死亡天使特工，从以下列表选择：
• 突击仲裁者军士，从以下选项中各选择一
件装备：
○ 喷火手枪或者重型爆矢手枪
○ 链锯剑，动力拳套，动力武器或者雷
霆锤
或者装备有以下选项：
○ 等离子手枪；链锯剑
• 仲裁者军士，从以下选项中各选择一件
装备：
○ 自动爆矢步枪、爆矢步枪或追猎者爆矢
步枪
○ 链锯剑，动力拳套，动力武器或者雷
霆锤
• 星际战士连长
请继续阅读背面规则
cards.text_en:
ANGELS OF DEATH
KILL TEAM
ARCHETYPE: SECURITY, SEEK & DESTROY
OPERATIVES
↘ 1 ANGEL OF DEATH operative selected from
the following list:
• ASSAULT INTERCESSOR SERGEANT with
one option from each of the following:
○ Hand flamer or heavy bolt pistol
○ Chainsword, power fist, power weapon or
thunder hammer
Or the following option:
○ Plasma pistol; chainsword
• INTERCESSOR SERGEANT with one option
from each of the following:
○ Auto bolt rifle, bolt rifle or stalker
bolt rifle
○ Chainsword, fists, power fist, power
weapon or thunder hammer
• SPACE MARINE CAPTAIN
CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

cards.image: 10-02-小队选择-死亡天使杀戮小队-2.png
cards.text:
↘ 5 名死亡天使特工，从以下列表选择：
• 突击仲裁者掷弹兵
• 突击仲裁者战士
• 歼灭者狙击手
• 重装仲裁者炮手
• 仲裁者炮手，装备有附加榴弹发射器以及以
下一种选项：
○ 自动爆矢步枪；双拳
○ 爆矢步枪；双拳
○ 追猎者爆矢步枪；双拳
• 仲裁者战士，装备有以下一种选项：
○ 自动爆矢步枪；双拳
○ 爆矢步枪；双拳
○ 追猎者爆矢步枪；双拳
除了战士特工以外，上述的每一名特工只能被纳
入您的杀戮小队一次。
一些死亡天使规则会提及“爆矢武器”。这
里指的是名称中带有“爆矢”一词的远程武
器，例如追猎者爆矢步枪，重型爆矢手枪等。
cards.text_en:
↘ 5 ANGEL OF DEATH operatives selected from
the following list:
• ASSAULT INTERCESSOR GRENADIER
• ASSAULT INTERCESSOR WARRIOR
• ELIMINATOR SNIPER
• HEAVY INTERCESSOR GUNNER
• INTERCESSOR GUNNER with auxiliary
grenade launcher and one of the
following options:
○ Auto bolt rifle; fists
○ Bolt rifle; fists
○ Stalker bolt rifle; fists
• INTERCESSOR WARRIOR with one of the
following options:
○ Auto bolt rifle; fists
○ Bolt rifle; fists
○ Stalker bolt rifle; fists
Other than WARRIOR operatives, your kill team
can only include each operative on this list once.
Some ANGEL OF DEATH rules refer to a
‘bolt weapon’. This is a ranged weapon that
includes ‘bolt’ in its name, e.g. stalker bolt
rifle, heavy bolt pistol, etc.

cards.text:
死亡天使
阵营规则
战团战术
每一个星际战士战团都是拥有独特战斗思维
的武装兄弟会，其中的每一位战斗修士都拥
有独特的技能和性格。这些战争手段可能会
遭到千年神秘仪式的包装，但是依旧和创立
时一样残暴有效。
在选择您的杀戮小队时，为己方死亡天使特工
选择一个首要和次要战团战术在战斗中生效。多
次选择同样的战团战术不会叠加效果。
设计师注解：如果您正在进行一系列游戏，
例如一场战役或者比赛，那么您必须在每一场
战斗中选择同样的首要和次要战团战术（您依
旧可以通过“灵活战术”战略计谋来更换次
要战术)。
战团战术选项将在单独的卡片上表示
cards.text_en:
ANGEL OF DEATH
FACTION RULE
CHAPTER TACTICS
Each Space Marine Chapter is a martial brotherhood
with its own combat philosophies, suited to the unique
skills and temperaments of its battle-brothers. These
tenets of war may be clothed in esoteric rituals built up
over thousands of years, but remain as brutally effective
as when they were first laid down.
When selecting your kill team, select a primary
and secondary CHAPTER TACTIC for friendly
ANGEL OF DEATH operatives to gain for the
battle. Multiple instances of the same CHAPTER
TACTIC aren’t cumulative.
Designer’s Note: If you’re playing a series of
games, i.e. a campaign or tournament, you
must select the same primary and secondary
CHAPTER TACTIC for every battle (you can
still change the secondary with the Adaptive
Tactics strategy ploy).
CHAPTER TACTIC OPTIONS ARE PRESENTED ON
THEIR OWN CARD

cards.text:
死亡天使
阵营规则
战团战术
1. 猛攻
该特工的近战武器拥有“撕裂”武器规则。
2. 决斗家
每当该特工进行近战或反击时，您的每一次普通
成功可以格挡一次未结算的关键成功（除非敌方
特工的武器拥有“残暴”武器规则)。
3. 坚决
您可以忽略任意对该特工 APL 属性的修正，
并且该特工不受敌方特工 “震荡”武器规则的
影响。
请继续阅读背面规则
cards.text_en:
ANGEL OF DEATH
FACTION RULE
CHAPTER TACTICS
1. AGGRESSIVE
This operative’s melee weapons have the
Rending weapon rule.
2. DUELLER
Whenever this operative is fighting or retaliating,
each of your normal successes can block one
unresolved critical success (unless the enemy
operative’s weapon has the Brutal weapon rule).
3. RESOLUTE
You can ignore any changes to this operative’s
APL stat and it isn’t affected by enemy
operatives’ Shock weapon rule.
CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

cards.text:
4. 隐匿
每当一名特工对该特工进行射击时，如果您可以
保留任何掩护豁免，那么您可以保留额外一次掩
护豁免，或者将一次掩护豁免作为关键成功进行
保留。本规则的效果不能与制高点地形提供的增
益效果叠加。
5. 机动
• 该特工在执行后撤行动时可以少消耗 1AP。
• 该特工可以在敌方特工的控制范围内执行冲
锋行动，并且可以在这么做时离开那名特工
的控制范围（随后照常需要满足那次移动的
要求)。
6. 强健
每当一名敌方特工对该特工进行射击时，结果为
5+ 的防御骰为关键成功。
请继续阅读背面规则
cards.text_en:
4. STEALTHY
Whenever an operative is shooting this operative,
if you can retain any cover saves, you can retain
one additional cover save, or you can retain one
cover save as a critical success instead. This
isn’t cumulative with improved cover saves from
Vantage terrain.
5. MOBILE
• This operative can perform the Fall Back action
for 1 less AP.
• This operative can perform the Charge
action while within control range of an enemy
operative, and can leave that operative’s
control range to do so (but then normal
requirements for that move apply).
6. HARDY
Whenever an operative is shooting this operative,
defence dice results of 5+ are critical successes.
CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

cards.text:
7. 神射手
每当该特工在没有执行冲锋、后撤或转移行动的
激活中进行射击时，其爆矢武器拥有“精准 1”
和“严重”武器规则。
8. 攻城战专家
该特工的远程武器拥有“集中”武器规则。每当
该特工进行近战或反击时，敌方特工不能进行
协助。
cards.text_en:
7. SHARPSHOOTER
Whenever this operative is shooting during
an activation in which it hasn’t performed the
Charge, Fall Back or Reposition action, its
bolt weapons have the Accurate 1 and Severe
weapon rules.
8. SIEGE SPECIALIST
This operative’s ranged weapons have the
Saturate weapon rule. Whenever this operative
is fighting or retaliating, enemy operatives
cannot assist.

cards.text:
死亡天使
阵营规则
阿斯塔特
这些经受了基因强化的超人们的存在意义只
有一个：战争。
在每一名己方死亡天使特工的激活期间，特工
可以执行两次近战行动或者两次射击行动。如果
选择执行两次射击行动，那么其中至少有一次必
须选择使用一件爆矢武器进行攻击，并且如果两
次行动都使用了爆矢狙击步枪或重型爆矢枪进行
攻击，那么第二次行动必须消耗额外 1AP。
每一名己方死亡天使特工可以进行反应，无论
其拥有的命令。
cards.text_en:
ANGEL OF DEATH
FACTION RULE
ASTARTES
These genetically modified superhumans are made for
one purpose: war.
During each friendly ANGEL OF DEATH
operative’s activation, it can perform either two
Shoot actions or two Fight actions. If it’s two
Shoot actions, a bolt weapon must be selected
for at least one of them, and if it’s a bolt sniper
rifle or heavy bolter, 1 additional AP must be
spent for the second action if both actions are
using that weapon.
Each friendly ANGEL OF DEATH operative can
counteract regardless of its order.

cards.text:
死亡天使
战略计谋
战斗条令
星际战士十分崇敬《阿斯塔特圣典》的教
导，利用其灵活的战术条令来歼灭敌人。
从下方选择一个战斗条令。每当一名己方死亡天
使特工执行选择条令描述的行动时，其武器拥
有“平衡”武器规则。
• 毁灭条令：对一名位于其 6" 外的敌方特工进
行射击。
• 战术条令：对一名位于其 6" 内的敌方特工进
行射击。
• 突击条令：近战或反击。
cards.text_en:
ANGEL OF DEATH
STRATEGY PLOY
COMBAT DOCTRINE
Space Marines hold the teachings of the Codex Astartes
in highest esteem, employing its flexible combat
doctrines to annihilate their enemies.
Select one COMBAT DOCTRINE from those
presented below. Whenever a friendly ANGEL
OF DEATH operative is x, its weapons have
the Balanced weapon rule. X is the COMBAT
DOCTRINE you selected.
• Devastator Doctrine: Shooting an operative
more than 6" from it.
• Tactical Doctrine: Shooting an operative within
6" of it.
• Assault Doctrine: Fighting or retaliating.

cards.title_en: AND THEY SHALL KNOW NO FEAR
cards.text:
死亡天使
战略计谋
他们无所畏惧
星际战士拥有超凡的勇气和坚定的意志，就
算是面对究极的恐惧之物或者看似不可能的
绝境也绝不会动摇。
您可以忽略任何己方死亡天使特工因受创而导
致的属性变化（包括武器数据）。
cards.text_en:
ANGEL OF DEATH
STRATEGY PLOY
AND THEY SHALL KNOW NO FEAR
Space Marines possess extraordinary courage and are
utterly unflinching in the face of terrifying horrors and
overwhelming odds.
You can ignore any changes to the stats of
friendly ANGEL OF DEATH operatives from being
injured (including their weapons’ stats).

cards.text:
死亡天使
战略计谋
灵活战术
很少由战士能够像星际战士一样灵活变通。
他们会通过自身的经验来替代《阿斯塔特圣
典》中的教导，及时调整自己的战略。
更改您的次要战团战术。请注意，这个计谋的效
果将持续至转折点结束，因此在转折点结束时会
重新使用原本的次要战团战术。
cards.text_en:
ANGEL OF DEATH
STRATEGY PLOY
ADAPTIVE TACTICS
There are few more tactically flexible warriors than
the Adeptus Astartes. Supplementing the teachings
of the Codex Astartes with their own experience,
Space Marines may adjust their strategies at a
moment’s notice.
Change your secondary CHAPTER TACTIC. Note
this ploy only lasts until the end of the turning
point, at which point your original secondary
CHAPTER TACTIC returns.

cards.text:
死亡天使
战略计谋
不屈不挠
现在是不屈纪元。人类帝国展开了一场驱逐
恐惧之物的浩大远征，而阿斯塔特修会的战
士们也因这一正义的使命而受到激励。
每当一名特工对一名己方死亡天使特工进行射
击时，如果您掷出了两次或更多失败，那么您可
以将其中一次舍弃，并将另一次失败作为一次普
通成功进行保留。
cards.text_en:
ANGEL OF DEATH
STRATEGY PLOY
INDOMITUS
This is the Era Indomitus. The Imperium wages
galaxy-spanning crusades to drive back the horrors
that plague it, and the battle-brothers of the Adeptus
Astartes are spurred on by this righteous purpose.
Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly
ANGEL OF DEATH operative, if you roll two or
more fails, you can discard one of them to retain
another as a normal success instead.

cards.text:
死亡天使
交战计谋
调整条令
星际战士杀戮小队为了击败敌人能够迅速调
整自己的战略。迅速的手势信号和突然的通
讯示意着战斗手段的切换。
当一名己方死亡天使特工在激活期间执行一次
行动之前或之后使用本交战计谋。如果您在当前
转折点期间使用了“战斗条令”战略计谋，那么
您可以更改之前选择的战斗条令。
cards.text_en:
ANGEL OF DEATH
FIREFIGHT PLOY
ADJUST DOCTRINE
Adeptus Astartes kill teams adapt their strategies on the
fly to overcome the foe. Swiftly traded hand signals and
abrupt vox exchanges herald a shift in doctrine.
Use this firefight ploy during a friendly ANGEL OF
DEATH operative’s activation, before or after it
performs an action. If you’ve used the Combat
Doctrine strategy ploy during this turning point,
change the COMBAT DOCTRINE you selected.

cards.text:
死亡天使
交战计谋
超人体格
受到基因改造的星际战士能够承受那些足够
将凡人杀死的伤势。
在一名特工对一名己方死亡天使特工进行射击
时，您可以在掷防御骰步骤中使用本交战计谋。
您可以将一次普通成功作为关键成功进行保留。
cards.text_en:
ANGEL OF DEATH
FIREFIGHT PLOY
TRANSHUMAN PHYSIOLOGY
The genetically modified physiology of a Space
Marine is capable of resisting wounds that would kill a
lesser being.
Use this firefight ploy when an operative is
shooting a friendly ANGEL OF DEATH operative,
in the Roll Defence Dice step. You can retain
one of your normal successes as a critical
success instead.

cards.text:
死亡天使
交战计谋
震慑突袭
阿斯塔特修会能够以惊人的速度和力量进行
攻击，链锯剑的响声与残暴的突袭意味着死
亡的到来。
当一名死亡天使特工在执行了冲锋行动的转折
点中执行近战行动时，在结算攻击骰步骤开始时
使用本交战计谋。直到那次行动结束前：
• 其近战武器拥有“震荡”武器规则。
• 您在那次流程中首次进行出击时，造成额外 1
点伤害（最多 7 点)。
cards.text_en:
ANGEL OF DEATH
FIREFIGHT PLOY
SHOCK ASSAULT
The Adeptus Astartes strike with exceptional speed and
strength, the roar of chainswords and brutal assaults
spelling death for their foes.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly ANGEL OF
DEATH operative is performing the Fight action
during an activation in which it performed the
Charge action, at the start of the Resolve Attack
Dice step. Until the end of that action:
• Its melee weapon has the Shock weapon rule.
• The first time you strike during that sequence,
inflict 1 additional damage (to a maximum
of 7).

cards.text:
死亡天使
交战计谋
复仇之怒
在被激怒后，一名星际战士可能会展现出惊
人的力量和体能。
在一名己方死亡天使特工进行反应时使用本交
战计谋。那名特工可以在那次反应期间无消耗额
外执行一次 1 AP 的行动，但是这两次行动必须
不同。
cards.text_en:
ANGEL OF DEATH
FIREFIGHT PLOY
WRATH OF VENGEANCE
When roused to anger, a battle-brother of the Adeptus
Astartes may be spurred to acts of extraordinary
strength and athleticism.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly ANGEL
OF DEATH operative is counteracting. It can
perform an additional 1AP action for free during
that counteraction, but both actions must
be different.

cards.text:
死亡天使
阵营装备
纯洁印章
战团牧师会将纯洁印章授予星际战士，它们上
面写有的祝福能够让持有者更加奋勇地作战。
每个转折点限一次，在一名己方死亡天使特工
进行射击、近战或反击时，如果您掷出了两次失
败，那么您可以将其中一次舍弃，并将另一次失
败作为普通成功进行保留。
cards.text_en:
ANGEL OF DEATH
FACTION EQUIPMENT
PURITY SEALS
Awarded by the Chapter’s Chaplains, purity seals are
inscribed with blessings and inspire the bearer to fight
with increased vigour.
Once per turning point, when a friendly ANGEL
OF DEATH operative is shooting, fighting or
retaliating, if you roll two or more fails, you can
discard one of them to retain another as a normal
success instead.

cards.text:
死亡天使
阵营装备
战团圣物
许多星际战士都携带着各种由死去同伴制成的
骇人圣物。携带着这些物品的战士为了致敬光
荣牺牲的兄弟们会更加努力地战斗。
在您使用“复仇之怒”交战计谋时，如果被指
定的己方特工拥有交战命令，那么那次计谋消
耗 0CP。
cards.text_en:
ANGEL OF DEATH
FACTION EQUIPMENT
CHAPTER RELIQUARIES
Many Space Marines bear macabre relics taken from the
bodies of their fallen. Those who bear these inspirational
items fight all the harder to honour the sacrifice of
their battle-brothers.
You can use the Wrath of Vengeance firefight ploy
for 0CP if the specified friendly operative has an
Engage order.

cards.text:
死亡天使
阵营装备
偏移肩盾
除了展示连队和个人徽记以外，一位星际战士
的偏移肩盾能够在近战格斗中提供保护。
每个转折点限一次，在一名己方死亡天使特工
进行近战或反击时，您可以在对手掷攻击骰后，
进行重掷前使用本规则。若使用，您的对手不能
在那次流程中将任何结果低于 6 的攻击骰作为关
键成功进行保留（例如“致命”、“撕裂”和
“严重”武器规则)。
cards.text_en:
ANGEL OF DEATH
FACTION EQUIPMENT
TILTING SHIELDS
As well as displaying company colours and personal
heraldry, a Space Marine’s tilting plate serves to protect
the bearer in the press of melee combat.
Once per turning point, when a friendly ANGEL OF
DEATH operative is fighting or retaliating, after
your opponent rolls their attack dice, but before
re-rolls, you can use this rule. If you do, your
opponent cannot retain attack dice results of less
than 6 as critical successes during that sequence
(e.g. as a result of the Lethal, Rending or Severe
weapon rules).

cards.text:
死亡天使
阵营装备
占卜仪
占卜仪的种类诸多。这些扫描装置能够侦测到
动态、分析大气情况并揭示热源反应。
每个转折点限一次，在一名己方死亡天使特工
执行射击行动并选择有效目标时，您可以使用本
规则。若使用，那么直到那次激活（或反应）结
束前，位于那名己方特工 8" 内的敌方特工不能
被遮挡。
cards.text_en:
ANGEL OF DEATH
FACTION EQUIPMENT
AUSPEX
Auspexes come in many forms. These scanning devices
can detect motion, analyse atmospheric conditions and
reveal heat signatures.
Once per turning point, when a friendly ANGEL
OF DEATH operative performs the Shoot action
and you’re selecting a valid target, you can use
this rule. If you do, until the end of the activation/
counteraction, enemy operatives within 8" of that
friendly operative cannot be obscured.
